Dalea · BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen · Full-time

Starts when our funding round closes

Build full-stack AI agents for science, with freedom, room to be creative, and real ownership, in a lively startup in Copenhagen.

An AI agent is only as useful to a scientist as the data it can see and trust. Dalea gives research labs structured data with full provenance, and we want AI co-scientists that do real scientific work on top of it. You'll own the AI side of that.

What you'll own

• 
The agent harness and the framework for AI co-scientist agents, from architecture to the workflows they run.

• 
Our MCP integrations, which give agents access to lab data with a traceable record of what they do.

• 
Model choices: following the field, testing new models against what labs actually need, and adopting what works.

• 
How we evaluate AI quality.

• 
The infrastructure the AI runs on: inference, model serving and agent execution.

• 
Full-stack work wherever the AI needs deeper integration with the platform, and help elsewhere when the team needs it.

What you bring

Must-haves

• 
You've designed and built an LLM agent system used in production, and made the architecture decisions yourself.

• 
Strong full-stack TypeScript (React, Next.js or close equivalents), and you're comfortable in Python.

• 
You've owned the direction of a technical area, including a significant rework.

• 
You've shipped quickly in a small team or an early-stage product.

Nice to have (none of them required)

• 
MCP servers or clients, agent frameworks or harness tooling (open source counts)

• 
Tools for scientists, or a background in bioinformatics, computational biology or AI for science

• 
Mastra or another TypeScript agent framework

• 
Open-weight models, through inference APIs or self-hosting

• 
Kubernetes

• 
Systems where provenance or audit trails matter

You don't need lab or biology knowledge, a PhD or Danish. Hands-on, shipped work counts more than research or publications. If you match the must-haves, apply, even if you have none of the nice-to-haves.

Our stack

TypeScript, Next.js and React. Python for our MCP service. An agent harness built on Mastra. Docker Compose and Kubernetes, hosted on Scaleway.

How we work

Our dev team is the two founders plus up to three new developers, led by our CTO. We discuss progress and priorities closely and continuously, and we expect you to take part: share ideas early, argue for what you think is right, and change course when the evidence says so.

You won't need permission to fix what's broken, and what you build reaches production quickly. We work together at BioInnovation Institute 3–5 days a week. We're building the team and the way we work, and that happens best in person.

About Dalea

Dalea is a data management platform for biology and lab workflows. Experiments, structured data, samples and inventory sit in one place, with full data provenance. Everything a lab builds in Dalea can be packaged and shared, so we're building a GitHub for life science: labs publish and reuse each other's workflows instead of rebuilding them from scratch. We work with biotech startups, academic labs, pharma R&D and CROs.

Timing and our funding round

This position depends on our current funding round closing, which we expect in February/March 2027. We can make a conditional offer before then, and we'll be open with you about the timing throughout the process.

What we offer

• 
Salary: DKK 725,000–900,000 per year, depending on experience

• 
Warrants: under the Danish §7P scheme

• 
Pension: through ASE

• 
Location: BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen, on-site 3–5 days a week. You'll need to live in the Copenhagen area or be willing to move here. We're happy to hear from people relocating within the EU.

• 
Language: English

• 
Start: when the round closes

How to apply

Apply here with your LinkedIn profile, your CV and short answers to a few questions. No cover letter needed.

We're also hiring a Senior AI Engineer. You're welcome to apply for more than one.

For more information or questions please contact us at recruiting@dalea.tech

Perks and benefits

This job comes with several perks and benefits

Flexible working hours

Flexible working hours

Skill development

Skill development

Near public transit

Near public transit

Remote work allowed

Remote work allowed

Equity package

Equity package

Working at

Dalea

A data platform for life science research, where experiments, data and workflows stay structured, traceable and easy to share. Dalea is a data management platform for research in biotech, pharma and academic labs. Scientists keep experiments, structured data, samples and inventory in one place, with full data provenance, in tools that feel familiar to anyone coming from Excel and Word. Today, much of that work is scattered across spreadsheets, personal computers and paper notebooks. Results are hard to find and harder to trust, so teams often re-run experiments rather than track down the ones they’ve already done. In Dalea, everything a lab builds can be packaged and shared: templates, add-ons and whole workflows. Labs can publish, discuss and reuse each other’s work instead of rebuilding it from scratch. Think of it as a GitHub for life science. The same structured, traceable data is what lets AI agents work reliably on real lab data. Dalea is built for regulated research. It has a full audit log, 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11 compliant infrastructure, and full provenance for everything that happens in the platform. It’s hosted in the EU. We’re a small team at BioInnovation Institute in Copenhagen, working with biotech startups, academic labs, pharma R&D teams and CROs.

Dalea · BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen · Full-time·

Starts when our funding round closes.

Keep a Part 11 and Annex 11 compliant lab data platform secure, reliable and trusted, and own the infrastructure it runs on.

We ask pharma and biotech teams to trust a young company with their most valuable research data. That's a big decision, and they're right to be careful. Dalea already has the safeguards. You'll keep them strong, improve them, and make them easy to verify.

What you'll own

• 
The infrastructure: Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Scaleway, CI/CD, monitoring and backups.

• 
Security: access control, encryption, logging and incident response.

• 
Our GxP setup, which is already built: a full audit log, 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11 compliant infrastructure, W3C PROV provenance for every entity and operation, rollback engines, and export to machine-readable regulatory formats. You'll audit it, maintain it and make it better.

• 
Our ISO 27001 certification and the controls behind it.

• 
Controlled releases, and validation support for customers who run GxP work in Dalea.

• 
Making trust verifiable: clear security and compliance documentation, and joining customer reviews when the questions get technical.

What you bring

Must-haves

• 
You've owned production infrastructure and deployment (containers, CI/CD, cloud) for a system holding sensitive data.

• 
Hands-on security engineering: access control, encryption, logging and incident response.

• 
Hands-on experience with ISO 27001 or SOC 2, or with GxP and regulated software (computer system validation, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11). One of the two is enough.

• 
You've built and maintained production platform software in a small team or early product where you made decisions.

Nice to have (none of them required)

• 
Experience with both compliance areas above

• 
Vendor audits by pharma customers

• 
Part 11 or Annex 11 systems in practice

• 
Provenance or lineage systems (W3C PROV)

• 
Customer security questionnaires

• 
Kubernetes

• 
TypeScript or Python

You don't need deep frontend skills, lab or biology knowledge, a PhD or Danish. If you match the must-haves, apply, even if you have none of the nice-to-haves.

TypeScript, Next.js and React. Python for our MCP service. An agent harness built on Mastra. Docker Compose and Kubernetes, hosted on Scaleway.

You won't need permission to fix what's broken, and what you build reaches production quickly. We work together at BioInnovation Institute 3–5 days a week. We're building the team and the way we work, and that happens best in person.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Help Us drive Data analytics and AI-Powered Business Transformation

**Are you passionate about data, analytics, and AI? Then you could be the one we are looking for.

**About the Role:

**We are looking for a skilled and proactive Data & AI Platform Engineer to help shape our next generation of digital capabilities.

In this role, you'll design and develop modern data platforms, integrations, and analytics solutions that empower automation, AI adoption and intelligent business processes across the organization.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, ERP specialists, process owners, BI developers, and application teams to transform data into actionable insights and create scalable solutions that unlock the value of AI.

This is more than a traditional data engineering role. You'll play a key part in building the infrastructure and capabilities that allow the business to leverage technologies such as Microsoft Copilot, AI agents, machine learning, intelligent automation, and advanced analytics.

**What You'll Do

****Build the Foundation for AI

**

• Design, build, and maintain enterprise data platforms, data warehouses, and semantic models.

• Develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines that make trusted data available across the organization.

• Ensure data quality, governance, security, and documentation are embedded into all solutions.

• Drive data accessibility.

**Enable Intelligent Applications & Automation

**

• Develop integrations between Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure services, manufacturing systems, APIs, and external platforms to gather data.

• Support the development of AI-enabled applications and business solutions.

**Empower Analytics & Business Decisions

**

• Deliver trusted datasets for reporting, dashboards, and self-service analytics.

• Design scalable data models that support both operational reporting and AI-driven insights.

• Partner with business stakeholders to turn challenges into data-driven solutions.

• Promote best practices for data and AI adoption throughout the organization.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, Data Warehouse Developer, Application Developer, or similar role.

• Strong SQL and data modeling

• Understanding of modern data engineering principles, governance, and securit

• Experience with one or more technologies like Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake or DBT, Azure Data Services, Azure Data Factory, SQL, Python, C#, Databricks (optional)

**Nice to Have

**

• Experience building and maintaining cloud-based data platforms and integration solutions.

• Experience with scalable data architectures and modern data pipelines.

• Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations or other ERP platforms.

• Experience with Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Copilot Studio.

• Understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or machine learning concepts.

• Experience exposing and managing enterprise data for AI consumption.

• Power BI experience.

**You ar****e someone who:

**

• Is passionate about solving business challenges with data and technology.

• Is curious about AI and emerging technologies.

• Can bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions.

• Combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

• Takes ownership and drives initiatives from idea to implementation.

• Enjoys collaborating across teams and influencing positive change

**What We Offer

**

• A central role in shaping our organization's AI and data strategy.

• The opportunity to build platforms that enable AI, automation, analytics, and digital innovation.

• Hands-on experience with modern Microsoft technologies, cloud platforms, and AI solutions.

• Significant influence on architecture, standards, and technology choices.

• Close collaboration with business and technology leaders.

• A flexible environment that encourages experimentation, learning, and innovation.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 7 years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience.

• Experience building business cases through workshops or product demos to business executives.

• Experience developing partnerships with technical stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists).

• Experience positioning and selling technical solutions in data management, analytics, infrastructure, or AI/ML.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Experience positioning modern cloud data platforms, lakehouses, real-time streaming, or GenAI platforms against legacy or other proprietary enterprise systems.

• Experience working with Global System Integrators, hyperscalers, or ISVs to co-sell and accelerate pipeline.

• Experience closing large-scale data and AI transformation deals within specific regulated or high-growth enterprise verticals (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing).

• Practical understanding of how modern cloud architectures, data governance (e.g., cataloging, lineage, compliance), and clean data estates enable AI and real-time analytics.

• Ability to communicate in English and Danish or Swedish fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

**About The Job

**As the Agentic Data Cloud Sales Specialists team, we work together with Field Sales Representatives (Account Managers), Customer Engineers, and our partners to help our customers modernize their operational and analytical data foundations on GCP. We enable them to transition to modern, unified cloud architectures that position data as the absolute foundation for AI success and power next-generation AI and intelligent applications. As a master of complex lakehouse solutions, data governance, and AI, you are the exact sales expert we need to translate technical capabilities into high-impact business outcomes.

You will be at the forefront of driving Google Cloud's most critical data and AI growth. In this role, you will drive growth by securing net-new greenfield logos and identify untapped, uncommitted workloads. You will partner with Field Sales Representatives, Customer Engineers, and Partners to execute joint Data+AI plays that establish long-term data platform standardization.

You are a master of value-selling. You will engage with line-of-business (LoB) leaders, CDO, CAIO, and CFO to discover critical pain points, build robust business cases (ROI/TCO reduction), and demonstrate the quantifiable business value of modernizing data estates on GCP.

Additionally, you will guide technical stakeholders and position Google Cloud's Agentic Data Cloud suite (BigQuery, Knowledge Catalog, Borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB) as the premium data intelligence platform for AI. You will present demos that showcase how unified, well-governed data foundations power secure, hallucination-free AI agents and real-time experiences.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.860000 - kr.880000 (DKK) + 100% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Deliver against quota and achieve or exceed strategic business and growth goals. Drive net-new greenfield logos and workloads in existing accounts through proactive campaigns.

• Run complex, multi-threaded business cycles from initial discovery and value hypothesis to ROI business case creation and commercial close.

• Engage business leaders, Chief Data Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Marketing Officer, Chief AI Officer, through value-selling, tying modern Data & AI capabilities to quantified business outcomes.

• Align cross-functionally with FSRs and partners to execute joint Data+AI plays, driving platform standardization and co-sell motions.

• Whiteboard modern architectures (BigQuery, Spark, Spanner, AlloyDB) to demonstrate how unified data foundations power high-performance, hallucination-free AI agents.

Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for Sales Operations Specialist to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists.

About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we are around 450 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Sales Operations Specialist who wants to make a difference.

The Role

As a Sales Operations Specialist, you will support the sales organization and other parts of Truesec through sales administration and the coordination of sales-related processes. The role is central to ensuring that our sales operations run smoothly, efficiently, and in line with internal processes, policies, and business requirements.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with a variety of functions across the organization, including Sales, Finance, Legal, Expert Services, and Managed Services. You will play an important part in driving structure, quality, and efficiency throughout our business and customer-facing processes.

As the first Sales Operations Specialist in Denmark, you will have a unique opportunity to shape and develop the role locally while being part of an established team based in Stockholm and Malmö. The role includes occasional travel to our Swedish offices to support collaboration and team development.

Examples of responsibilities:

• 
Create and administer offers, agreements, and digital signing.

• 
Manage deal registrations, incoming communication, and administrative follow-up.

• 
Set up and administer projects in Visma.

• 
Support Finance with data and processes to ensure accurate and efficient invoicing.

• 
Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth and quality-assured sales processes.

Your Potential Background

We believe you are structured, detail-oriented, and service-minded, with a strong ability to combine administration, coordination, and business understanding. You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy creating structure, driving initiatives forward, and ensuring that every detail is handled with care and accuracy.

You are comfortable managing multiple priorities simultaneously, have a strong attention to detail, and communicate clearly and effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.

We believe you have:

• 
Experience from a similar role within Sales Operations, sales support, administration, or business coordination.

• 
Strong organizational skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple workflows simultaneously.

• 
The ability to analyze information and translate insights into documentation, reports, and recommendations that support decision-making and follow-up.

• 
Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

It is an advantage if you have:

• 
Experience working with Visma, Jira, or similar finance or administration systems.

• 
Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Finance, and Legal teams in business-critical processes.

• 
A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and business needs.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Danish work permit.

Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you’ll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company – and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

jobs.occupation: Head of Medical Affairs International Markets
jobs.description:
Are you knowledgeable within allergy treatment? Do you like working in an international setting facing different cultures? Bring your expertise in allergy, immunology and medical strategy to a global role where your scientific leadership can make a meaningful difference.

The position

The Head of Medical Affairs International Markets will serve as a therapeutic and disease area expert who is responsible for the Medical Affairs strategy development and structured, consistent and strategically aligned medical engagement across International Markets. International Markets in ALK covers all territories outside Europe and North America. The primary focus is Asia, Middle East and Latin America. The International Markets team is small and diverse with people sitting all over the world and currently covering 12 different native languages. You will be reporting directly to SVP International Markets, Morten Essendrop.

Your Primary Tasks Will Be

Medical Strategy Development

• Responsible for the Medical Affairs strategy and plan for International Markets, leveraging learnings and best practices from Region Europe and Region US Medical Affairs.

• Ensure consistency between strategies, communication and messaging within ALK and across partners allowing for local adaption.

• Support partners with medical expertise and education on ALK products.

• Accountable for publication planning (including congress abstracts, poster presentations, manuscripts) working in close collaboration with local teams and Global Medical Affairs.

External Medical Representation

• Define stakeholder engagement strategies and develop professional relationships with thought leaders to ensure education and scientific communication on ALK products and therapeutic areas of interest. Lead scientific and external engagement strategy for International Markets.

• Represent ALK as medical expert and speaker at selected international congresses, advisory boards, partner meetings and scientific events within International Markets.

• Act as a senior medical ambassador for ALK in key International Markets.

Your profile

We expect that you are a medical doctor with the following qualifications:

• Strong knowledge of the immunology field, strong presentation skills and scientific expertise. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with allergy treatment including allergen specific immunotherapy.

• Knowledge of Medical Affairs standards and processes.

• Ability to develop Medical Affairs strategies and tactical plans.

• Build and interact with a network of allergy/immunology experts, partners and represent ALK in scientific and medical matters. Capable of conducting doctoral level discussions with key customers.

• Ability to collaborate with Global Medical Affairs, and Commercial Operations functions locally and globally. Working in a matrix environment.

Become a part of ALK

We provide an attractive working environment for individuals looking for both personal and professional development. ALK is a global pharmaceutical company specialised in allergy immunotherapy. We are driven by a high level of professionalism, integrity, an open-minded approach and contributing to an inspiring and fun working environment together with our colleagues. You will be part of an engaged and informal team who values skill and knowledge creation. The result of your efforts will be significant throughout the organisation, and you will be able to actively influence and challenge the status quo.

The position is international with up to 50-60 days of travelling per year. For the ideal candidate flexibility in the workplace can be arranged.

Apply

Apply by attaching your CV and a short letter of motivation.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all our job applicants. Hence, we prefer that you do not add images to your application documents. We evaluate applications and call for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to apply! We reserve the right to take down the advert when we have found the right candidate.

Do you want to learn more about our company, we encourage you to visit us at www.alk.net.

We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Allergy impacts and challenges the lives of millions of adults and children every day. At ALK, our purpose is to improve the lives of people living with allergies. Building on our strong heritage, we are guided by our strategy, Allergy+, that shows us a clear path towards this goal through focus, innovation, cultivation and optimisation.

Read more about our corporate strategy and our ambitions for growth

Fair and unbiased recruitment at ALK

At ALK, we believe that every candidate deserves to be evaluated fairly and respectfully. Our recruitment process is designed to give each applicant an equal opportunity, regardless of their background. Read more about fair and unbiased recruitment at ALK.

If you are applying from North America, please know that we are committed to fair, unbiased and non-discriminatory recruitment practices and to complying with all applicable federal, state and local employment laws. Employment decisions are made based on qualifications, skills and experience, without discrimination on the basis of legally protected characteristics. For more information, please visit the official websites of the relevant authorities: U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) and Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP).

Data is becoming one of the most important foundations for Blue Water’s future. As we continue our digital transformation through BlueCore and the implementation of SAP S/4HANA and CargoWise, we are building the capabilities needed to support future analytics, AI and smarter decision-making across the business. This is a rare opportunity to join at a stage where you can influence and shape the outcome.

As our new Data Architect, you will help shape how data flows across Blue Water. You will establish the principles, models and standards that enable data to be understood, trusted and used consistently across a global organisation. Your work will influence major business initiatives and help create the foundation for technologies and capabilities we have yet to introduce.

This is where you make a difference

You will join our Data Management team within Operational Excellence and work closely with Enterprise Architecture, IT, application teams and business stakeholders across the organisation.

One of your first priorities will be to create transparency across our data landscape. You will map key data domains, data flows, integrations and dependencies, helping us understand where we are today and what needs to evolve to support tomorrow’s business.

From there, you will play a central role in defining the target-state data architecture and building the roadmap to get there. This includes developing conceptual and logical data models, establishing architectural principles and guiding decisions around critical business data and system ownership.

You will also help shape the architecture behind our future Data Platform, ensuring we have the right foundations for metadata, lineage, data quality, security and governance. Along the way, you will review solution designs, challenge assumptions when needed and act as a trusted sparring partner for architects, project teams and business stakeholders. We value being close to key stakeholders and work in a hybrid setup, with around two to three days per week on site in Esbjerg.

Key responsibilities include:

• Defining and maintaining Blue Water’s enterprise data architecture, standards and modelling principles

• Supporting strategic transformation initiatives, including BlueCore, by ensuring alignment with agreed architectural principles

• Translating business requirements and data definitions into scalable and implementable data models

• Guiding internal teams and external partners on data-related architecture decisions

What you bring

You have experience working with data architecture, data modelling or solution design in complex enterprise environments. You understand that good architecture is not about drawing perfect diagrams. It is about creating practical solutions that balance business needs, technology realities and long-term sustainability. Essential skills:

• Experience with data architecture, data modelling or solution design across multiple systems or business domains

• Experience with cloud data platforms and integration architecture

• SAP S/4HANA experience, particularly around Business Partner data

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics to different audiences

• Professional proficiency in English

It is an advantage if you also have experience with:

• Data engineering, integration or enterprise architecture

• Master data management, metadata, lineage and data quality disciplines

• Event-driven, API-based and batch integration patterns

• CargoWise, logistics or transport-related operations

• Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake or similar technologies

• Advanced analytics, AI or relevant certifications such as TOGAF or DAMA

Why Blue Water

You will become part of a well-established Data Management team with strong professional capabilities across governance, master data, migration and quality.

What characterises the team is not only its expertise, but also its willingness to help each other succeed. We work closely together, challenge each other’s thinking and believe that the best solutions are created through collaboration across business and IT.

As part of the wider Operational Excellence organisation, you will work alongside colleagues specialising in process improvement, training and change management. Together, we are helping Blue Water build the capabilities needed for the future.

Interested?

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of data at Blue Water. If you are ready to make a real impact in a global organisation undergoing significant transformation, we would love to hear from you.

For questions about the role, please contact Kamil J. Karolak, Head of Data Management.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What we do – Together we create solutions

Blue Water Shipping is a global provider of all logistics services in modern supply chain management. Founded in Denmark in 1972, Blue Water is a global organisation of professionals, skilled in offering complete and tailor-made solutions to any shipping requirement anywhere in the world. We offer clients the best service and highest quality in the industry.

The company is represented by more than 80 offices in 30 countries worldwide, combining a strong global network with local expertise. Every day, our 2,800 employees present a broad range of services, from standardised solutions delivered with optimal user and customer focus, to tailor-made projects with co-created solutions for unique customer needs.

**Finance Business Partner, VELUX A/S - Østbirk

****Do you enjoy turning data into meaningful insights and working closely with people to influence decisions and drive performance? With a passion for business partnering and a strong analytical mindset, you could be our next Finance Business Partner in Østbirk.

****Meet your future team

**As part of our Global Finance team, you will join a group of dedicated and experienced colleagues supporting our production sites in Østbirk and Brædstrup. Together, we work to bring financial insights to life and enable informed business decisions that create value across the organisation.

In this role, you will work closely with operational leaders, managers, and finance stakeholders, building trusted relationships and gaining a deep understanding of our manufacturing business. We value collaboration, knowledge sharing, openness, and continuous learning, creating an environment where everyone can contribute and develop their skills.

**What We Offer

**As Finance Business Partner, you will play a key role in supporting business performance and helping operational teams make data-driven decisions. You will have the opportunity to work in a collaborative environment where your expertise and insights contribute directly to business success.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Partner with managers and operational teams to provide financial insights and decision support.

• Monitor and analyse efficiency, production performance, material consumption, budgets, and key operational KPIs.

• Prepare financial analyses, business cases, and presentations to support strategic and operational decision-making.

• Support budgeting, forecasting, and monthly reporting processes.

**What You Will Bring

Whether your background is in Finance Business Partnering, Controlling, Financial Analysis, or a related field, you are motivated by creating value through insights and strong stakeholder relationships.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Hold a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.

• Have strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data into meaningful business insights.

• Build positive and productive relationships with stakeholders across all levels of the organisation.

• Have advanced Excel capabilities and an interest in reporting and visualisation tools such as Power BI.

jobs.description:
Are you motivated by ensuring full compliance in a complex and fast-evolving regulatory landscape? Material Planning · Customs & Transportation · Procurement · Finance · Manufacturing · Tax/Legal · IT/Reporting · SST · Warehousing

What you'll bring

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy in declarations and documentation

• Analytical ability to interpret and apply legislation

• Proactive, service-oriented mindset with strong stakeholder collaboration skills

• Danish language proficiency and valid Danish ID Card

• Working proficiency in English

Nice-to-have: Descartes software experience

Working at STG & What to expect

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Help shape Coloplast’s growth agenda by sourcing, evaluating and executing strategic transactions across our global business.

You will join a team of five high-performing specialists across strategy, business development and M&A. Are you ready to shape the tax function of an international shipping company?

Clipper is enhancing its internal tax capability as part of a continued focus on strengthening governance and decision support across the organisation. We are therefore looking for a dedicated and hands-on Tax Manager to be based at Clipper’s headquarters in Copenhagen.

Today, tax matters at Clipper are handled across Finance, Legal and external advisors. With increasing regulatory complexity and risk exposure, we are establishing a more formalized and proactive tax function. The Tax Manager will play a key role in building this capability and embedding robust tax governance across the organization.

You will report directly to the CFO and work closely with the Head of Legal & Corporate Affairs and Head of Controlling and external advisors.

What will be your responsibilities

You will be responsible for both strategic and operational tax matters across Clipper’s global activities. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

• Establish and maintain Clipper’s tax governance framework, including a tax risk register and clear processes for identifying, assessing and managing tax risks.

• Review the tax implications of material transactions and challenge tax positions and advice from external advisors where relevant.

• Own and oversee transfer pricing policies, intercompany agreements, benchmarking and documentation.

• Monitor and manage cross-border tax matters, including withholding tax, freight tax and permanent establishment risks.

• Oversee compliance with Danish tonnage tax requirements, including calculations, documentation and relevant controls.

• Coordinate corporate tax, VAT and employment tax compliance and reporting across jurisdictions, ensuring timely filings and robust documentation.

• Advise on tax matters related to international employee mobility and contractor arrangements.

• Monitor relevant tax and regulatory developments, including OECD Pillar Two and environmental and emissions-related taxes, and assess their impact on Clipper.

• Act as Clipper’s internal tax expert and trusted sparring partner, advising management on tax implications of strategic and operational decisions.

What we are looking for

At Clipper, our employees shape our work environment, so bringing a positive attitude is essential.

• We imagine that you have a relevant educational background within finance, tax, business administration, law or similar, combined with solid experience in corporate and international tax.

• You have hands-on experience with tax governance and tax risk management, combined with strong knowledge of transfer pricing, cross-border taxation and international tax principles.

• You are comfortable working with external advisors while also challenging and validating tax positions when needed.

• You are structured and analytical, but also pragmatic and commercially minded.

• You enjoy taking ownership, working independently and turning complex tax matters into practical advice and solutions for the business.

• You communicate confidently across functions and levels of the organisation and are fluent in both Danish and English.

• Shipping experience, including knowledge of tonnage tax or other shipping-specific tax matters, is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Don’t meet every single requirement?

If you’re enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You could be the ideal candidate for this position, or for another opportunity with us.

What you will love about us

At Clipper, you will become part of a growing and professional work environment where we strive to be the best. We offer:

• A key role with significant influence on Clipper Bulk's tax framework and risk profile

• The opportunity to build and shape an internal tax function

• Close collaboration with senior management and exposure to strategic decision-making

• A welcoming and inclusive work environment with a variety of socal, sports, and cultural events throughout the year

• Attractive employee benefits, including pension, health, dental and critical ilness insurance

• Beautiful office facilities in Nordhavn, located near the metro with on-site paring, delicious lunch arangement and access to fitness facilities and a personal trainer.

Application and recruitment process

Please submit your CV and cover letter through our application portal by 22nd November 2026.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will be treated with full discretion.

The recruitment process consist of two interview rounds. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a first interview, while candidates progressing to the second round will be asked to complete a personality assessment beforehand. Confidential reference checks will be conducted for final candidates.

Learn more about Clipper at clipper-bulk.com, LinkedIn, and Instagram.

Clipper is an industry leader in dry bulk, an operator, a pool manager, and a specialist in steel services. We operate a modern fleet of approximately 120 handysize and supramax vessels, transporting a wide range of cargo from dry bulk to break bulk. Clipper is commercially headquartered in Copenhagen and employs a staff of around 100 onshore worldwide__. We are a global workplace built on five shared values: Dependable, Curious, Collaboration, Hands-on and Family. We believe in learning from one another and welcome people with a growth mindset and ambition.

Sustainability initiatives - we strive to make a positive impact. As a maritime player with a global presence at sea and onshore, we recognize our social, environmental, and ethical responsibility. We push for positive development by responsibly running our business and promoting sustainable business behavior in our network. Read more about sustainability initiatives on our website.

IST is looking for an experienced Development Manager who thrives at the intersection of technology, people, and delivery and who is ready to lead and evolve our development organization to the next level.

At IST, we’re not just building software—we’re shaping the future of education. Our digital tools connect schools, teachers, students, and families in smarter, more meaningful ways. With over five million users across Europe, our mission is clear: to make learning easier, more engaging, and more impactful for everyone.

Joining IST means working in an international, collaborative environment where your leadership and ideas make a real difference. You’ll guide and inspire development teams, influence technical direction, and contribute to products used by thousands of schools—while growing alongside experienced colleagues who are passionate about improving education.

Role overview

We are looking for a Development Manager who is passionate about people, software development and building high-performing engineering teams. In this role, you will lead and support a few development teams while working closely with Product Owners, Architects and other stakeholders to create high-quality software solutions.

As a Development Manager, your primary focus will be leadership, team development, delivery and creating an environment where engineers can thrive and do their best work. We also believe you are curious about emerging technologies and interested in how AI can support software development, collaboration and innovation.

Key responsibilities

• Lead, coach and support some development teams

• Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing engineering culture

• Support team members in their professional growth and development

• Ensure effective ways of working, agile processes and continuous improvement

• Collaborate with Product Owners and other stakeholders to align priorities and deliveries

• Drive recruitment, onboarding and team development activities

• Help teams remove obstacles and improve delivery capabilities

• Follow up on team goals, performance, engagement and work environment

• Encourage experimentation and learning around new technologies, including AI-driven tools and workflows

Role qualifications

We believe you have the following experience, capabilities and personal skills to succeed in this role:

• A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering or related field

• Previous experience in a leadership role within software development

• A background in software engineering or technical product development

• Strong communication and collaboration skills

• Experience working with agile development methodologies

• The ability to balance people management with business and delivery needs

• A coaching and supportive leadership style

• An interest in AI and how new technologies can improve the way teams work and deliver software

• Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken

What we offer
